title: eschscholzia minutiflora subsp. covillei
intro: Eschscholzia minutiflora subsp. covillei, commonly known as Dwarf California Poppy, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the poppy family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, relieving pain, and exhibiting antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Eschscholzia minutiflora subsp. covillei are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which have been shown to have anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects. While more research is needed to confirm its efficacy, traditional use of this plant suggests potential benefits for anxiety, insomnia, and other conditions, making it a subject of ongoing scientific investigation.
